🔬 Double-Blind Perceptual Evaluation Protocol

Independent Perceptual Evaluation Protocol & Pilot Benchmarks

Scientific credibility requires separating test harnesses from verified experimental findings. VoiceBox provides an open, double-blind perceptual evaluation harness (src/evaluation/blind_study_framework.ts) allowing researchers and community developers to conduct rigorous, randomized MUSHRA/ABX listening trials on identical lexical text (“I am completely fine with this decision.”).

Protocol Design: Multi-condition blind listening with randomized stimulus order, unbiased 8-way forced choice classification, and Wilson score 95% confidence intervals.
Pilot Sample Data: The preliminary figures below reflect exploratory lab pilot benchmarks ($N=12$ trials per condition) collected during harness validation, provided as baseline reference. Formal multi-participant clinical trials are tracked in docs/benchmarks.md.

❌ Why Conventional Cloud TTS Fails on Neutral Text

Neural diffusion and autoregressive vocoders learn joint embeddings of text tokens and acoustics. When the text is overtly positive (“I am completely fine...”), the text embeddings dominate the conditioning vector. The model produces cheerful, modal speech regardless of the emotion prompt. Without physical glottal clamping or respiratory models, listeners cannot perceive covert hostility or dejection.

✅ Why Biophysical Modeling Succeeds

VoiceBox decouples surface text from involuntary motor pathways. The vocal fold glottal parameters (Rd, Ps, CT/TA activation) are governed by involuntary limbic-PAG dynamics. Even when the words remain polite, listeners immediately recognize the 8.0 Hz neuromuscular tremor, pressed glottal phonation, or respiratory sigh dump because the human auditory cortex evolved specifically to decode these physiological cues.
